alerts.title: Optic Nerve Swelling Detected
alerts.message: Warning: Potential development of Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-Ocular Syndrome (SANS) detected.

alerts.title: High Cosmic Radiation Levels
alerts.message: Warning: Dangerous radiation levels detected, with potential exposure to Solar Particle Events (SPEs).

countermeasureProtocols.title: Thigh Cuffs & Fluid Shift Protocol
countermeasureProtocols.description: Use of venous occlusion thigh cuffs to prevent fluid shifts toward the head and reduce the risk of SANS.

countermeasureProtocols.title: ARED & Zero T2 Musculoskeletal Countermeasure Protocol
countermeasureProtocols.description: A combination of resistance and aerobic training exercises designed to prevent muscle atrophy and bone loss.
steps: Perform resistance exercises on ARED for 2.5 hours per day
Complete an aerobic session on Zero T2
Record heart rate and exercise load

countermeasureProtocols.title: Radiation Storm Shelter & Shielding Protocol
countermeasureProtocols.description: Protective procedures to follow when solar flares or elevated radiation levels are detected.
steps: Move to the designated radiation shelter
